19:96.text: [in the Oneness of Allâh and in His Messenger (Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم)]
and work deeds of righteousness, the Most Gracious

19:97.text: , only that you may give glad tidings to the Muttaqûn
, and warn with it the Ludd

19:98.text: And how many a generation before them have We destroyed! Can you
find a single one of them or hear even a whisper of them?

20:2.text: We have not sent down the Qur’ân unto you

20:3.text: But only as a Reminder to those who fear

20:4.text: Who has created the earth and high heavens.

20:5.text: (in a manner that suits His Majesty)

20:6.text: To Him belongs all that is in the heavens and all that is on the earth, and all that is between them, and all that is under the soil.

20:7.text: aloud, then verily, He knows the secret and that which is yet more hidden.

20:8.text: (none has the right to be worshipped but He)
! To Him belong the Best Names.

20:9.text: And has there come to you the story of Mûsâ

20:10.text: When he saw a fire, he said to his family: "Wait! Verily, I have seen a fire; perhaps I can bring you some burning brand therefrom, or find some guidance at the fire."

20:11.text: And when he came to it
, he was called by name: "O Mûsâ

20:12.text: "Verily I am your Lord! So take off your shoes; you are in the sacred valley, Tuwa.
